code: library(quanteda) #> Package version: 4.5.1 #> Unicode version: 15.1 #> ICU version: 74.2 #> Parallel computing: disabled #> See https://quanteda.io for tutorials and examples. toks <- tokens(data_corpus_inaugural, remove_punct = TRUE,                remove_numbers = TRUE) toks <- tokens_remove(tokens_tolower(toks), stopwords("en")) x <- dfm_trim(dfm(toks), min_termfreq = 5) year <- docvars(data_corpus_inaugural, "Year")  set.seed(2026) fit <- tot(x, year, k = 8, n_iter = 300) terms(fit, 8) #>      Topic1         Topic2       Topic3    Topic4       Topic5    #> [1,] "government"   "government" "us"      "government" "us"      #> [2,] "people"       "can"        "world"   "may"        "america" #> [3,] "states"       "must"       "can"     "people"     "nation"  #> [4,] "power"        "upon"       "people"  "states"     "must"    #> [5,] "upon"         "people"     "peace"   "great"      "people"  #> [6,] "may"          "world"      "new"     "public"     "new"     #> [7,] "constitution" "great"      "must"    "country"    "world"   #> [8,] "one"          "nation"     "freedom" "every"      "can"     #>      Topic6         Topic7         Topic8       #> [1,] "government"   "shall"        "people"     #> [2,] "people"       "can"          "upon"       #> [3,] "country"      "states"       "government" #> [4,] "upon"         "constitution" "public"     #> [5,] "states"       "government"   "states"     #> [6,] "constitution" "upon"         "shall"      #> [7,] "public"       "may"          "must"       #> [8,] "great"        "people"       "congress" plot(fit) pred <- predict(fit, x, type = "time") head(data.frame(actual = year, predicted = round(pred))) #>                 actual predicted #> 1789-Washington   1789      1857 #> 1793-Washington   1793      1873 #> 1797-Adams        1797      1849 #> 1801-Jefferson    1801      1861 #> 1805-Jefferson    1805      1851 #> 1809-Madison      1809      1859 cor(pred, year) #> [1] 0.9167397

code: library(topicsovertime) library(quanteda)  toks <- tokens(data_corpus_inaugural, remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE) toks <- tokens_remove(tokens_tolower(toks), stopwords("en")) x <- dfm_trim(dfm(toks), min_termfreq = 5) year <- docvars(data_corpus_inaugural, "Year")  set.seed(2026) fit <- tot(x, year, k = 8, n_iter = 300)  fit                      # summary of the model terms(fit, 10)           # top words per topic fit$psi                  # Beta parameters of each topic (normalized time) plot(fit)                # topic proportions over time, P(topic | time) plot(fit, type = "density")  # Beta density of each topic over time  topic_time(fit, c(1800, 1900, 2000))      # P(topic | time) at given times predict(fit, x, type = "topics")          # topic proportions of documents predict(fit, x, type = "time")            # predicted year of each document

title: Topics over Time for R
text: sampler follows paper. Three details differ literal reading : Beta density orientation. paper’s conditional printed (1 - t)^(ψ1 - 1) t^(ψ2 - 1), match method--moments estimates paired . package uses standard t^(ψ1 - 1) (1 - t)^(ψ2 - 1). Time normalization. Timestamps mapped onto [1e-4, 1 - 1e-4] rather exactly [0, 1], log densities stay finite earliest latest documents. Bounded Beta densities. method--moments update, Beta shapes kept 1 (mean, higher concentration). Without , topic collapse onto first last documents U-shaped Beta(≈0, ≈0) density stay locked . cost U-shaped topics (common early late, rare ) represented. hyper-parameters alpha (default 50 / k) beta (default 0.1) fixed, paper. number topics k must chosen user.
